plan.overview: Refactor upload button placement from Selected Mixins panel to Manage Uploaded Mixins popup for improved aesthetics and clearer UX. Remove previous implementation, add upload button at popup bottom aligned with existing controls, wire to existing upload function, and manually test the new workflow.

phases.name: Logic: Remove Upload Button from Selected Mixins Panel and Add to Manage Popup
phases.summary: Remove btn-selected-collector-upload button from Selected Mixins panel header, add upload button to Manage Uploaded Mixins popup at bottom.
phases.description:
Clean up previous implementation and implement the new button placement:

**Part A: Remove from Selected Mixins Panel (ui/html/index.html)**
1. Delete the btn-selected-collector-upload button element from the selected-collector section
2. Remove the selected-collector-header wrapper div (revert to simple title div)
3. Remove the inline flex styling that was added for the header
4. Result: Selected Mixins panel header returns to simple, clean appearance

**Part B: Add to Manage Uploads Popup (ui/html/index.html)**
1. Locate the uploads-popup div (id="uploads-popup")
2. Find the button container at the bottom (display: flex, justify-content: space-between)
3. Add new upload button to this container:
   - id="btn-uploads-popup-upload"
   - class="tool-btn" (reuse existing styling)
   - Font Awesome upload icon (fa-solid fa-upload)
   - title="Upload New Mixin"
   - aria-label="Upload New Mixin"
4. Position: in the button container, before or after clear/done buttons as appropriate
5. Styling: will inherit tool-btn class styling, consistent with clear/done buttons

**Implementation Details:**
- The uploads-popup already has flex container for buttons with clear-all and done buttons
- New button will be added to same flex container
- Spacing and styling automatically consistent via tool-btn class
- No new CSS needed (reuse existing .tool-btn styles)

**Files Modified:**
- ui/html/index.html (removed from panel, added to popup)

phases.name: Tests: Manual UI Testing with Upload Button in Popup
phases.summary: Verify upload functionality works from new location in Manage Uploaded Mixins popup and all related features continue to work.
phases.description:
Perform manual UI testing to validate the refactored upload workflow:

**Test 1: Verify Panel Cleanup**
- Load the page: http://localhost:8080
- Check Selected Mixins panel header
- Verify: NO upload button visible in panel header
- Verify: Panel header is clean with just title
- Verify: No broken layout or styling

**Test 2: Verify Popup Button Exists**
- Click "Manage Uploaded Mixins" button in toolbar
- Verify: Popup opens
- Verify: Upload button appears at bottom of popup
- Verify: Upload button is aligned with clear-all and done buttons
- Verify: Button has upload icon (fa-upload)
- Verify: Button has tooltip "Upload New Mixin"

**Test 3: Upload Functionality from Popup**
- In open Manage Uploaded Mixins popup:
- Click the new upload button
- Verify: File dialog opens
- Select a test YAML file
- File dialog closes after selection
- Verify: New file appears in uploads list in popup immediately
- Verify: New file appears in Uploads group in dropdown
- Verify: New file available in Selected Mixins selections

**Test 4: Multiple Uploads**
- With popup open, click upload button again
- Upload another file
- Verify: Both files now appear in popup list
- Verify: Both appear in dropdown Uploads group
- Close and reopen popup
- Verify: Both uploads persist in popup

**Test 5: Original Problematic URL**
- Load: http://localhost:8080/?input=ext_release.yaml&options=ext_options.yaml&combo=ext_digital_twin.yaml&expandedIds=id_3_2_1_1_4%2Cid_3_2_1_1_3%2Cid_3_4_2
- Verify: Uploads group appears in dropdown
- Click "Manage Uploaded Mixins"
- Verify: Popup opens and shows uploads
- Verify: Upload button present in popup
- Test upload flow as in Test 3

**Test 6: Uploads Group Functionality Unchanged**
- Verify: Uploads group still appears in dropdown at correct position
- Collapse/expand Uploads group in dropdown
- Verify: No errors
- Verify: Can still select individual uploads from dropdown
- Verify: Selected uploads appear in Selected Mixins panel

**Test 7: Console Verification**
- Open browser DevTools (F12)
- Go to Console tab
- Repeat Tests 3-5
- Verify: NO JavaScript errors
- Verify: NO 404 errors
- Verify: NO undefined reference errors
- Verify: Appropriate console logging if present

**Test 8: Edge Cases**
- Open popup with NO uploads stored
- Verify: Upload button still present and functional
- Upload a file
- Verify: File appears in previously-empty popup
- Delete all uploads via popup
- Verify: Upload button still works
- Upload again
- Verify: File appears immediately

Deliverables: Test execution report documenting all 8 test cases with pass/fail status.
